campaigns.scope: Five builds × four ordinary weapons, fixed seeds, normal movement/dash/pickup/purchase inputs. No direct edits to life, damage, clock, experience or RNG. Reduced rewards require all build cores to be affordable, with four to six final owned items; six slots are capacity, not guaranteed completion. This is an automated reachability check, not a human difficulty study.

browser.scope: Native menus, physical coin pickup, paused shop with frozen full snapshots, clean input release and native keyboard selection, real keyboard and CDP multitouch, scrolling, exact saves, continuous boss entry and ten-minute deadline. Stationary enemies, on-player coin funding and timeline-edge fixtures are explicit QA fixtures. Fourteen equipment effects on all four weapons are separately exercised in unit simulation tests.
